ensure_fitted_raise: ensure all ScaleFactor modules in a PyTorch nn.Module are fitted, raising ValueError if any are not
ensure_fitted_warn: check all ScaleFactor modules in a PyTorch nn.Module are fitted and log a warning instead of raising
review_ensure_fitted: review the ensure_fitted function that validates ScaleFactor modules recursively across all named submodules
summarize_ensure_fitted: summarize the ensure_fitted utility that checks fitted status of ScaleFactor children in a module tree
test_ensure_fitted: test the ensure_fitted function with a module containing unfitted ScaleFactor instances to verify error handling
